description: Task-assignee visibility leaks into the admin console: once a task is assigned, the admin can no longer see it — admin lists should show all records regardless of assignee
reproSteps: Assign a receiving/picking/put-away/verify task to a user (admin task-assignment), then open the same task list in the admin console as an admin → the assigned task is missing; only visible to that assignee on the PDA
remarks: Record only — not fixed yet. Per spec 2026-11-01-task-assignee-design.md the assignee filter is PDA-side only; assigneeFilter in src/db/user-scope.ts must stay empty for admin callers. Investigate which admin list route passes a username into the filter
